acceptance_condition: Returns at least one finding consisting of a direct quote or close paraphrase from the Smit file, with the exact `===== PDF PAGE N =====` marker(s), that states either a limitation of the study or that MAD performance is sensitive to hyperparameters (e.g., agreement intensity) and thus difficult to optimize.
rationale: The acceptance condition requires coverage of stated limitations or sensitivity to hyperparameters. The paper's abstract and Section 4 explicitly state that MAD protocols are more sensitive to hyperparameter settings and difficult to optimize, and the limitations paragraph in the conclusions mentions API variability and cost. This finding grounds D15 (limitations) and informs the evaluation plan's hyperparameter control.
text: Extract from papers/text/smit-et-al-2023-going-mad.txt at least one anchored finding stating limitations of the study or sensitivity of MAD to hyperparameters (e.g., agreement intensity, number of agents/rounds), quoting or closely paraphrasing the relevant passage(s) and carrying the exact `===== PDF PAGE N =====` marker(s).
